Illinois biometric law — specifically BIPA — requires written opt-in consent before collecting their voiceprints and also requires the company to publish a retention schedule. These two points are not currently addressed in the rollout approval memo, and they need to be added as conditions before I can sign off.

Provide the union with 14 calendar days' advance notice before enrolling covered employees, built into the six-week rollout schedule.
Update the labor checklist to reflect the identified CBA requirements before final approval.
Formally request the vendor amendment to delete voiceprints within 30 days and prohibit secondary analytics use, and include the amendment in the legal approval package.
